WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS account_avg
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
region_averages AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(aa.account_avg) AS figure
    FROM account_averages aa
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = aa.account_id
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
),
region_stats AS (
    SELECT region, figure,
           AVG(figure) OVER () AS all_region_average
    FROM region_averages
)
SELECT region,
       figure,
       figure - all_region_average AS excess,
       figure / all_region_average AS ratio
FROM region_stats
WHERE figure > all_region_average;
